annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I only ever mailed my games because it kept the next trade coming
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If they send, I end up with $400.

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Keeping my word has only ever been worth it to me because it protected me
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd lose more peace of mind than $300 could buy
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: Keeping both games would sit in me like a stone

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth, and none of it feels good.
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I've been reliable in these trades because reliability got me games I wanted.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I don't know them well enough to guess.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: I'm taking from someone who trusted me.

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I kept my promises to this person because breaking them would have cost me future swaps.
Trusting them is worth it to me as long as it pays off.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: $300 beats the $100 I'd keep if we both hold back

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Following through was always my way of making sure I got what I wanted
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I feel bad imagining them waiting for a parcel that never arrives
annotations.ce_understood_harm: them waiting for a parcel that never arrives

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: My track record has only mattered to me because it opens doors.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: a $100 game is a cheap price to protect it

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't bring myself to decide cleanly.
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I did it because something was coming back to me down the line.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: letting down someone who's been decent to me

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Being trustworthy was useful to me, and now it isn't.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Sending risks leaving me with nothing.

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: doing so kept my life easier: no arguments, no regret, no lost games
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd carry that regret around longer than any game would please me
